# Plain Compass

> Plain Compass is a personal travel journal sharing firsthand travel experiences, destination reviews, hiking routes, accommodation insights, and practical transport tips.

## Website

[https://plaincompass.github.io/](https://plaincompass.github.io/)

## About

Articles cover destination reviews, routes, transportation, and accommodation.
All articles are based on firsthand travel experiences and personal
observations unless otherwise noted. Current coverage includes South Korea,
with additional destinations planned.

## Topics

- Travel Experiences
- Destination Reviews
- Hiking Trails
- Transportation Tips
- Accommodation Reviews
- Walking Trails

## Published Articles

### China

- [Beijing Travel Hub: Forbidden City, Summer Palace, Temple of Heaven, and Huanghua Qingcheng](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/beijing/beijinghub/): The trip covered Beijing’s major imperial landmarks, with a separate day tour to Huanghua Qingcheng for boat rides and Great Wall scenery.
- [Can You Reach the Datong Volcano Area From Datong Airport Without a Taxi?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/datong/datong/): My experience traveling from Datong Airport to the Datong Volcano area, including public transport challenges, taxi costs, a foreigner-friendly hotel, and practical tips for independent travelers.
- [Crowded but Stunning: My Quick Visit to Beijing's Temple of Heaven](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/beijing/templeofheaven/): The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests was grander than expected, but dense crowds and influencer photo shoots made the park feel busier than the Forbidden City.
- [Forbidden City in June: Crowded Heat, North Gate Garden, and Water Reflections](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/beijing/forbiddencity/): I braved a 30-minute wait and sweltering crowds at the Forbidden City, finding a quiet garden near the north gate and peaceful waterfront reflections.
- [Is Chaka Salt Lake Worth Visiting? My Experience Taking the Daytime Sleeper Train from Xining](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/qinghai/chaka-salt-lake/): My experience visiting Chaka Salt Lake from Xining, including the five-hour daytime sleeper train, photography spots, crowds, altitude preparation, and why staying overnight is worth it.
- [Is the Datong Volcano Viewpoint Worth Visiting Without a Tour?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/datong/datongvolcano/): A personal walking guide to the Datong Volcano area, including the volcano viewpoint near the volcano district, trail conditions, volcano views, and practical travel tips.
- [Man Xi Hotel: European Charm & Local Life in Qingdao Old Town](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/qingdao/qingdao-old-city-hengshan-road/): Stayed at Man Xi in Qingdao's old town. Enjoyed superior afternoon tea, a light breakfast, and the best fruit I've tasted in China.
- [Shanghai: Zootopia Nights, Wukang Mansion, and Zhujiajiao](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/shaghai/shanghaihub/): Shorter lines than Orlando at Zootopia, a 30-second walk to Wukang Mansion, and quiet mornings in Zhujiajiao.
- [Submerged Great Wall and Riverside Serenity at Huanghua Qingcheng](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/beijing/huanghuaqingcheng/): Rode a boat to a submerged section of the Great Wall, took a lift train up the mountain, and enjoyed quiet riverside views and a peaceful walk.
- [Summer Palace in Beijing: Views from the Tower of Buddhist Incense](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/beijing/summerpalace/): I spent two hours exploring the Summer Palace in Beijing, enjoying panoramic views from the Tower of Buddhist Incense and the park's peaceful atmosphere.
- [Ta'ershan Monastery: Monks' Chants and a 2,600m Altitude Walk](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/qinghai/taerusu/): It takes 20 minutes to climb the hill to reach Ta'ershan at 2,600m altitude. It is characterized by monks' chants and 7 stone stupas at the entrance.
- [Wukang Mansion: 30-Second Walk & Early Morning Photos](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/shaghai/wukang-mansion/): Stayed at Home Inn for a 30-second walk to Wukang Mansion. Captured quiet early morning photos before crowds and explored nearby bakeries in Changning.
- [Xining, China: Rocky Mountains and Dry Late-August Weather](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/qinghai/xining/): 3N/4D trip to Xining for Qinghai Lake. Dry, cool late-August weather with stunning rocky mountain views. Taxi transfer cost 120 yuan. Use Alipay/WeChat Pay.
- [Xining: Bus to Ta'ershan and Train to Chaka Salt Lake](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/qinghai/xininghub/): Took Bus 909 to Ta'ershan for a 20-minute uphill walk and a 5-hour sleeper train to Chaka Salt Lake from Xining.
- [Zhanqiao Pier: Fog, Seagulls, and Crowds in Qingdao](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/qingdao/zhanqiao-pier/): Walked Zhanqiao Pier in thick fog, overwhelmed by seagulls and TikTok crowds. Tried China-only McMornings but found the chaos exhausting.
- [Zhujiajiao: A Quiet Water Village Escape Near Shanghai](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/shaghai/zhujiajiao/): Sitting on a swing bench under a purple acacia tree, I found Zhujiajiao peaceful and uncrowded. Easy subway access and flat paths made this historic water village a perfect quiet break from Shanghai.
- [Zootopia Village at Shanghai Disneyland: Night Lights & Cloud Time Hotel](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/china/shaghai/shanghai-disneyland/): Stayed at Cloud Time Hotel and visited Zootopia Village at Shanghai Disneyland. Nighttime lighting was magical, and moderate crowds made the trip smooth.

### Japan

- [Nukabira Lake Winter Walk: Quiet Snowy Landscape in Hokkaido](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/japan/obihiro/nukabiralake/): A peaceful stroll around Nukabira Lake in February 2026, capturing clear skies, Mount Asahi in view, and a surprise wild deer encounter. The ice was melting and the snow thinner than expected, but the easy path and accessible bus ride from Obihiro made it a gentle, Nordic‑style winter forest experience.
- [Obihiro Travel Hub](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/japan/obihiro/obihirohub/): Explore Obihiro, Hokkaido, Japan, featuring Nukabira Lake, Tokachigawasuikei, and Butadon.
- [Obihiro: Exploring the Snowy Landscapes, Red Squirrel Encounter, and Delicious Butadon](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/japan/obihiro/obihiro/): Experience Obihiro, Hokkaido, Japan, featuring snowy landscapes, red squirrel encounters, and the best butadon (grilled pork) in Japan.
- [Tokachikawa Onsen (Obihiro): A Peaceful Hot Spring Escape in Hokkaido](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/japan/obihiro/tokachionsenobihiro/): A one-night, two-day trip to Tokachikawa Onsen in Hokkaido, featuring a unique hot spring emerging from moss, peaceful open-air baths, and quiet small-town atmosphere. Includes tips on transportation, logistics, and what to bring.

### South Korea

- [Is Mt. Gwanak a Good Mountain to Hike During a Seoul Trip?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/south-korea/seoul/gwanak/): A personal hiking guide to Mt. Gwanak from Gwacheon Station, including the route to Yeonjuam Temple, trail tips, and a quiet prayer spot near the summit.
- [Is Mt. Mindungsan Worth Hiking in Jeongseon?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/south-korea/gangwon/jeongseon-mindoong/): A personal hiking review of Mt. Mindungsan in Jeongseon, including the route from the second parking lot, the steep and slippery descent toward Jeungsan Elementary School, travel tips, reservation notes, and seasonal advice.
- [Is the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge a Difficult Hike?](https://plaincompass.github.io/posts/south-korea/chungnam/geumsan-wellness-walk/): A personal review of the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge, including its uphill section, event experience, reservation notes, accessibility considerations, and a visit to the Seven Hundred Patriotic Martyrs Tomb.
